meta.title: Pending Approvals panel allows quick Approve / Reject
gaps: Open the Pending Approvals icon and verify the side panel lists approvals pending on the user with summary details
Open View More Details for a pending approval and verify the expanded information
Approve or reject a pending approval using the panel's quick action
Verify the acted-on approval is cleared from the pending task list
